en: The image is a sepia-toned or black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a town nestled in a hilly landscape. In the foreground, there are densely-packed buildings with pitched roofs and some prominent chimneys, indicative of an early industrial landscape. In the background, a tall viaduct or railroad bridge stands out among green fields and scattered houses. The upper part of the postcard reads 'Sebnitz, Sächs. Schweiz', which points to its location.
